baseline_models.focus_anchor: The feminine perfect verb at word 3 governs the throat at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: An unnamed entity completes a trajectory at a specifically named bodily conduit. Reaching supplies the terminal motion, while the throat localizes the limit at the shared passage of breath and intake.

activation_trace.role: Arrival at an endpoint supplies the completed trajectory and its limit.
The bodily passage for breath and food fixes that endpoint at a life-critical constriction.

changed_reading.before: Something merely arrives at an anatomical location.
changed_reading.after: The clause stages a terminal approach to the body's narrow life-channel, where continued passage becomes a limit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The reaching verb can carry delivery, and its destination is the bodily passage immediately implicated in breath and utterance.
baseline_models.mechanism: The delivery branch of the reaching root and the throat's conduit function permit a second reading in which something comes to the last bodily interface of expression. The clause can therefore hold both physical arrival and communication at the point where voice may fail.

activation_trace.role: Delivery of a message turns reaching from bare locomotion into transmission to a receiver.
The breath passage provides the bodily interface through which voiced response is enabled or blocked.

changed_reading.before: The reaching is only a physiological movement.
changed_reading.after: The arrival can also be heard as a delivery reaching the body's final gate of breath and utterance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence moves through recitation, delivery, discourse, and denial before the focus arrival. That sequence strengthens the focus-only delivery model: verbal reception and verbal evasion culminate at the organ whose breath makes response possible, so bodily fact overtakes discursive control.

activation_trace.role: Message-delivery supplies the transmission side of the focus verb.
The breath conduit becomes the embodied endpoint of verbal reception and response.

Renewed speech keeps the response to the delivered communication in the verbal domain.

structural_cues: Verses 77-82 form a recitation-to-delivery-to-response sequence immediately before the focus challenge.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recitation, delivery, discourse, denial, and a focus branch of message-delivery; I infer that the throat functions as the last response interface. A live alternative is that the discourse sequence and the physiological scene are adjacent without sharing a transmission mechanism.

changed_reading.before: An entity reaches a bodily endpoint.
changed_reading.after: Received truth and the audience's verbal evasion are forced into embodiment at the breath-and-voice gate, where denial can no longer remain merely speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: The event is timed and watched, yet a nearer presence is not seen. The throat therefore becomes more than an anatomical limit: it is an epistemic boundary where observers have maximal access to the visible body while remaining blind to the agency closest to the event.

activation_trace.role: Arrival at the endpoint supplies the event the observers witness.

Watching in 56:84 is answered by nearer-but-unseen agency in 56:85.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a timed gaze, nearness, and failed sight; I infer a split between visible bodily process and invisible effective agency. The live alternative is primarily a power contrast rather than an epistemic one.

changed_reading.before: The throat is simply the last observable bodily location.
changed_reading.after: The throat is the boundary at which close observation reaches its own limit: the body is visible, but the nearest agency and decisive process are not.

context_deltas.mechanism: Accountability frames the demand to restore the focus entity to its former state, and truth must be demonstrated by accomplishing that return. The throat acts as a one-way handover point: arrival there exposes the audience's inability to reverse the transfer.

The life-critical conduit localizes the point from which restoration is challenged.
Accounting and recompense supply the jurisdiction that the challengers claim to escape.
Return to the prior state defines the concrete reversal the observers cannot perform.
Truth verified by fulfilled action makes restoration the test of the audience's claim.

The feminine object pronoun in 56:87 resumes the unnamed feminine subject of the focus verb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accountability, a command to return the same feminine entity, and action as proof; I infer a jurisdictional handover at the throat. A live alternative is a general demonstration of helplessness without treating the anatomy as a checkpoint.

changed_reading.before: The reaching marks an ominous endpoint in the body.
changed_reading.after: The reaching marks an irreversible handover under a jurisdiction the observers cannot suspend, reverse, or disprove.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the failed-return challenge, the sequence divides into opposed receptions: privileged nearness, rest, good condition, and safety on one side; denial, deviation, prepared hot reception, and blazing heat on the other. The throat is recast as the shared gate before sorting, not as the final destination.

It remains anchored in the focus trajectory and named endpoint, with the earlier location imagery supplying only a scale analogy. Downstream prose should call it a possible cosmic-to-bodily echo, not identify the throat with a stellar station.

strongest_changes: Verses 84-87 turn terminal arrival into an observed but unmastered handover: human looking cannot disclose the nearer agency, and human power cannot return the focus entity.
Verses 88-94 recast the throat as a common gate before sharply differentiated receptions rather than as the final destination.
Verses 77-82 strengthen a secondary delivery-and-voice reading in which discourse and denial are overtaken at the bodily passage that enables response.
summary.what_was_special: The repeated challenge converts one compact anatomical clause into a test of sight, control, jurisdiction, and truth; the later parallel outcomes then reveal the endpoint as a shared threshold. The packet also sustained two contained cross-domain echoes without requiring them to displace the stronger model.
remaining_uncertainties: The feminine entity is not named in the focus ayah, so identifying it more specifically would exceed the focus wording.
The delivery-and-voice model is structurally supported but remains analogical rather than a grammatical identification of the implicit subject.
The closing certainty may scope the entire outcome sequence more directly than the throat event itself.
The cosmic-coordinate and narrow-aperture outliers are branch-driven echoes and should remain explicitly exploratory.
